en: Luminos is the Open Access monograph publishing program from UC Press. Luminos provides a framework for preserving and reinvigorating monograph publishing for the future and increases the reach and visibility of important scholarly work. Titles published in the UC Press Luminos model are published with the same high standards for selection, peer review, production, and marketing as those in our traditional program.
zh: Luminos 是加利福尼亚大学出版社的开放获取学术专著出版计划。它为学术专著出版的存续和振兴提供支持，并扩大重要研究成果的传播范围和可见度。入选 Luminos 的书目，在选题、同行评审、制作与推广方面均遵循出版社传统出版项目的同等标准。
